title: Non-surgical knee fracture treatment
description: Non-surgical knee fracture treatment is an outpatient procedure where your doctor treats your broken knee bone without surgery. Most uncomplicated knee fractures, particularly stress fractures or simple breaks without displacement, can heal without surgery. Your doctor will take X-rays to confirm the fracture type. You'll wear a cast, brace, or immobilizer to protect your knee. You'll need to avoid weight-bearing activities for several weeks, using crutches if necessary. Ice, elevation, and pain medication help manage discomfort and swelling. Periodic X-rays monitor healing progress. Physical therapy helps maintain your strength and flexibility while you heal. Once the cast is removed, therapy becomes more active to restore full function. Full healing typically takes 6-12 weeks depending on the fracture severity.
